title: Close-out admission covers the pre-closeout PR head; the close-out's own commits merge after it
body: Admission checks CI on the PR head as it stands when the close-out phase starts; the close-out job's own writes (retro, learnings) then integrate onto the epic branch and the PR's CI re-runs on them with nobody holding the close for that final green. A follow-up tick could gate the close-out's CLOSE on CI for the head that includes its own commits, making the rule cover the whole PR rather than everything before the last phase.
